questions.stem: The significance level is 5%. Out of 400 tests in which the null hypothesis is actually true, how many would you expect to reject it by chance?

questions.explain: Multiply both sides by 2 to get x̄ − 50 = 6, so x̄ = 56.
|x| > 2 means x is more than 2 away from 0, on either side. That is x < −2 or x > 2.

questions.stem: A table has 3 rows and 4 columns. How many cells does it have?
questions.explain: The rows and columns choices multiply: 3 × 4 = 12.

questions.stem: A density is f(x) = 2x on the interval from 0 to 1. What is the area under it from x = 0.5 to x = 1?
questions.explain: An anti-derivative of 2x is x². Evaluating from 0.5 to 1 gives 1 − 0.25 = 0.75.
